target.statement: Mean β0 across the 22 OULAD courses (or a single course's mean β0, e.g. DDD_2013B = 29.8) computed via Union construction at ε = 1.5 over weekly z-standardized 10-feature activity profiles
target.dataset: OULAD (Open University Learning Analytics Dataset), 22 course presentations, N>22,000

compute.basis: OULAD is a small public CSV dataset (~10 VLE tables, a few hundred MB); the pipeline is weekly feature aggregation, z-scoring, Euclidean distance matrices and connected-component/union-find at ε=1.5 — all trivial on CPU; the main cost is re-implementing the Union Zigzag construction from the prose description since no code is linked.

blockers: No code or repository linked in the paper; Union Zigzag construction and ε=1.5 pipeline must be re-implemented from a prose description
Exact preprocessing details (which 10 VLE activity types, week alignment, handling of inactive learners) are underspecified, so exact numeric match to Table 1 is uncertain
title: Participation-Sensitive Convergence and the Fragment First, Converge Later Pattern in Asynchronous Online Learning: A Topological Analysis Across 22 OULAD Courses
